claims.verbatim:
Steamship Pereire (Fr), Duchesne, Havre May 10 via Brest
12th, with mdse and passengers, to Geo Mackenzie. May 15,
lat 48 5, lon 27 43, saw ship Maud (Br), bound E; 16th, lat
47 13, lon 35 26, saw ship Windgrave[?], bound W.
